mapper.insert: -- Insert stored file metadata without binary content. INSERT INTO stored_files ( id, owner_user_id, original_filename, stored_filename, storage_key, content_type, file_size, checksum_sha256, status_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{storageKey}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{checksumSha256}, 'STORED', #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.select: -- Select stored file metadata by primary key. SELECT sf.id AS file_id, sf.owner_user_id, sf.original_filename, sf.stored_filename, sf.storage_key, sf.content_type, sf.file_size, sf.checksum_sha256, sf.status_code, sf.created_at FROM stored_files sf WHERE sf.id = #{fileId} AND sf.status_code = 'STORED'
mapper.insert: -- Insert one document submission linked to a stored file. INSERT INTO document_submissions ( id, file_id, submitted_by, resource_type_code, resource_id, document_type_code, status_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{submissionId}, #{fileId}, #{submittedBy}, #{resourceTypeCode}, #{resourceId}, #{documentTypeCode}, 'SUBMITTED', #{submittedBy}, #{submittedBy} )
mapper.select:
-- Select document submissions for review and user history screens. SELECT ds.id AS submission_id, ds.file_id, sf.original_filename, sf.content_type, sf.file_size, ds.resource_type_code, ds.resource_id, ds.document_type_code, ds.status_code, ds.submitted_by, ds.created_at AS submitted_at, ds.reviewed_by, ds.reviewed_at, ds.review_note FROM document_submissions ds INNER JOIN stored_files sf ON sf.id = ds.file_id
ORDER BY ds.created_at DESC, ds.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count document submissions for paginated list. SELECT count(1) FROM document_submissions ds INNER JOIN stored_files sf ON sf.id = ds.file_id

-- Select one document submission with stored file metadata. SELECT ds.id AS submission_id, ds.file_id, sf.original_filename, sf.content_type, sf.file_size, ds.resource_type_code, ds.resource_id, ds.document_type_code, ds.status_code, ds.submitted_by, ds.created_at AS submitted_at, ds.reviewed_by, ds.reviewed_at, ds.review_note FROM document_submissions ds INNER JOIN stored_files sf ON sf.id = ds.file_id WHERE ds.id = #{submissionId}
mapper.update: -- Save latest document submission review decision. UPDATE document_submissions SET status_code = #{afterStatusCode}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewed_by = #{reviewerUserId}, reviewed_at = now(), updated_by = #{reviewerUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{submissionId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert review history for a document submission. INSERT INTO document_submission_reviews ( id, submission_id, reviewer_user_id, before_status_code, after_status_code, review_note ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{submissionId}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{beforeStatusCode}, #{afterStatusCode}, #{reviewNote} )
mapper.select: -- Select partner verification access fields. SELECT pv.id AS verification_id, pv.member_user_id, pv.partner_user_id FROM partner_verifications pv WHERE pv.id = #{verificationId}
-- Select application progress access fields. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, ap.member_user_id FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.id = #{progressId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII document submission audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
